title: 16.21. Kusalattika, Cittasahabhūduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Kusalaṁ cittasahabhuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo nacittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … pañca.
Akusalaṁ cittasahabhuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naakusalo nacittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … pañca.
Abyākataṁ cittasahabhuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo nacittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate terasa.
Kusalaṁ nocittasahabhuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo nanocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … pañca.
Akusalaṁ nocittasahabhuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naakusalo nanocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … pañca.
Abyākataṁ nocittasahabhuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo nanocittasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate terasa.
